summary: The step that updates Nora's view of a room after each reply no longer creates notes, which stops the flood of duplicate notes that never got updated.
details: After each tagged turn, a second model rewrites Nora's short position for that room. It was also allowed to open notes, and it wrote most of them: 52 of the 64 notes in use.
It never saw the notes already open, so the same question asked in new words became a new note each time, and it could only create notes, never update them.
It also opened notes about Nora's own failures, such as an image that would not send, as if they were questions the group had left open.
Notes are now created only when someone asks Nora on a tag, and by the separate pass that reads the room, checks what is already open and updates instead of duplicating.
limitations: Notes it already created stay open until they are retired; this change does not clean them up.
Nora's own failures are no longer tracked as notes anywhere; they belong in logs and error reports.
